notes.text: Hyman’s [printed notice, vol. III, p. 903](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=70) reads “Rabbah Mar Mari.” The linked Bavli has Rabbah bar Mari in the wine-blessing discussion and the visit to Rava. The brackets in the translation mark this difference.

The linked Yerushalmi names Rabbi Tanchum bar Mari reporting Rabbi Yose in a discussion of property subject to a lien. [Heilprin’s Mari entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2402&lang=en) lists both Rabbah bar Mari and Tanchum bar Mari. That grouping leaves their fathers’ identity open.
